system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: desloppify update-skill claude # installs the full workflow guide
system_prompt_style.note: Desloppify is a CLI skill harness; it ships skill/prompt docs and stage prompt templates (stage_prompts.py, prompt_template.py) rather than a system prompt of its own.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Scan runs mechanical detectors across your codebase — dead code, duplication, complexity, test coverage gaps, naming issues, and more.
env_context_strategy.note: Scan results/packets are injected into agent context; agent also navigates repo with its own tools.

observation_format.note: CLI prints text reports; --json and query.json/packet JSON outputs.

tool_call_format.note: The agent invokes desloppify as CLI commands with flags.

tool_count.note: Command set is large (scan, next, resolve, plan, review, backlog, exclude, status...) but no tool schema list is in evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Autofix handles what it can; the rest needs manual or agent work.
edit_primitive.note: Desloppify provides no edit tool to the model; edits are made by the host agent's own tools (autofix applies fixes internally).

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: desloppify update-skill claude # installs the full workflow guide — pick yours: claude, cursor, codex, copilot, droid, windsurf, gemini, rovodev
tool_schema_source.note: Interface is hand-written skill docs plus argparse CLI parsers (app/cli_support/parser.py).

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Start a persistent OpenCode server to avoid MCP cold-start overhead per batch
protocol_standardization.note: MCP mentioned only as host-agent overhead; no MCP client/server shipped in evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: scan ──→ score ──→ review ──→ triage ──→ execute ──→ rescan
loop_primitives.note: Fixed staged pipeline; triage produces a plan then execute loop; rescan verifies.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: It is the execution queue from the living plan, not the whole backlog.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Split the review across N parallel Claude subagents (one message, multiple Task calls). Each agent reviews a subset of dimensions.
multi_agent_topology.note: Reviews/triage stages are delegated to subagents/batch runner subprocesses.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: This spawns OpenCode subprocesses (`opencode run --format json`) for each batch

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Share any questionable candidates with me before excluding.
human_in_loop.note: Human attests/confirms triage stages via --confirm/--attestation; no per-call approval gate in harness.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: State persists in `.desloppify/` so progress carries across sessions.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: State persists across scans so it chips away over multiple sessions
long_term_memory.note: `.desloppify/` state files persist across runs; skills installed to agent skill dirs.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Re-running resumes from the last confirmed stage.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Review uses an LLM to assess subjective quality dimensions — naming, abstractions, error handling patterns, module boundaries.
self_verification.note: Mechanical detectors include linters (PMD, generic linter) and test coverage gaps; rescan verifies.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Your goal is to get the strict score as high as possible.
retry_policy.note: Loop repeats next→fix→resolve until score target; batch-level retries via --only-batches.

rollback.evidence_quote: Fix it, resolve it, run `next` again. Over and over. This is your main job.
rollback.note: No undo/revert mechanism appears in the evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The runner handles batch splitting, prompt generation, parallel execution, retry/stall detection, result extraction, merge, and trusted import automatically.
termination_condition.note: Score target is the loop's success condition; per-stage timeouts also bound runs.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: --profile ci skips slow and subjective phases
cost_controls.note: No token budget/cost cap or caching visible; profile only skips phases.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Codex batch runs default to `-s workspace-write`.
execution_isolation.note: Runs locally as a pip-installed CLI spawning agent subprocesses.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Codex batch runs default to `-s workspace-write`.
filesystem_access.note: Scoped to the scanned project workspace; reviewers told not to edit source files.

network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism appears in the evidence.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Manual override is safety-scoped: you cannot combine it with `--allow-partial`, and provisional manual scores expire on the next `scan`
permission_model.note: Guardrails exist over import/override operations (helpers/guardrails.py); sandbox mode allowlist for runners.

tracing.evidence_quote: each run gets its own directory with `run.log` (live timestamped events), `run_summary.json`, per-stage `prompts/`, `output/`, and `logs/`

replayability.evidence_quote: The command writes immutable packet snapshots under `.desloppify/review_packets/holistic_packet_*.json`; use those for reproducible retries.

eval_hooks.note: Scoring/scorecard is the built-in evaluation of codebase quality, not an external benchmark runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: provisional manual scores expire on the next `scan` unless replaced by trusted internal or attested-external imports
guardrails.note: Anti-gaming policies, attestation/integrity checks on imported assessments; blind packet filters reviewer input.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Desloppify gives your AI coding agent the tools to identify, understand, and systematically improve codebase quality.

open_source.evidence_quote: Non-open source companies who wish to commercialize it should refer to the [LICENSE](LICENSE) for transparent pricing details.
open_source.note: Source public but licence is not OSI (commercial pricing terms).

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: pick yours: claude, cursor, codex, copilot, droid, windsurf, gemini, rovodev
model_agnostic.note: Works with any host agent/model; batch runners for codex, opencode, rovodev.

first_release_date.note: Basis: the tag date given in evidence for v1.0; earlier tags not in evidence.
